name: PixJet – NextGen Image Optimizer & CDN
author: addonix

sections.description:
PixJet is a comprehensive WordPress plugin by Addonix Inc designed to optimize, secure, and accelerate your website’s media content. With features like image optimization, watermarking, and access to a Premium CDN network, PixJet enhances your website’s performance while protecting your valuable media assets.

When activated, PixJet automatically optimizes uploaded images, applies optional watermarks, and ensures global delivery with minimal latency (pro), giving your users a seamless experience.

Note: Do not use PixJet alongside other image optimization, CDN, or watermarking plugins to avoid conflicts.

Video Tutorial

Watch the quick start video to see PixJet in action:

Key Features

  • Image Optimization: Automatic compression without compromising image quality.
  • Watermarking: Add custom watermarks to protect your media assets from unauthorized use.
  • Premium CDN: Effortlessly deliver your images globally with lightning-fast load times.
  • Auto Workflow: Seamlessly optimize and protect media on upload.
  • User-Friendly Dashboard: Configure, manage, and monitor your media optimizations from a single interface.

Boost Your Website with Top-Notch Image Optimization Features

  • Lossless Compression – Remove unused data and compress images without sacrificing quality. This ensures that your visuals maintain their original clarity and detail, providing a high-quality experience for your users while reducing file sizes to enhance loading speeds.
  • Lossy Compression – Reduce file sizes even more with minimal quality loss, perfect for faster web performance. This method strikes a balance between image quality and file size, ensuring your images look great while loading quickly, enhancing the overall user experience.
  • Smart Lazy Loading – Speed up page load times by loading images only when they’re needed. This feature improves your site’s efficiency by deferring the loading of off-screen images until the user scrolls to them, significantly boosting page speeds and user satisfaction.
  • Convert to WebP – Change your images to WebP format to dramatically cut down file sizes while keeping them sharp. WebP is designed for the web, providing superior compression and quality, which helps improve your site’s speed without compromising on visual quality.
  • Convert to AVIF (Pro) – Get smaller, high-quality images with AVIF conversion for pro users. AVIF offers even better compression rates than WebP, enabling faster loading times and reduced bandwidth usage, perfect for professional websites that need top performance.
  • Bulk Optimize – Save time by optimizing many images at once with our easy-to-use bulk tool. Whether you’re uploading hundreds of photos or updating your entire media library, bulk optimization ensures all your images are efficiently compressed with minimal effort.
  • Auto Resize Images – Automatically adjust image sizes to maintain a consistent look on your site. This feature ensures that all your pictures fit perfectly within your site’s layout, enhancing the overall aesthetics and user experience by avoiding awkwardly cropped images.
  • Global CDN (Pro) – Deliver images quickly anywhere in the world with our global content delivery network. A CDN stores your images on servers globally, ensuring fast delivery to users no matter where they are, reducing latency and improving load times for a seamless experience.
  • Automated Optimization – Let our tool automatically keep your images optimized all the time. You can set it and forget it, knowing that our system will continually keep your images at their best, improving site speed and user experience without any manual effort.
  • No Server Impact – Enhance images without slowing down your server, ensuring your site stays fast. Our optimization processes run independently, so your server maintains its performance while delivering optimized images to your users.
  • Remote Configuration – Control your image settings from anywhere for ease and flexibility. Manage your optimization preferences remotely, allowing you to tweak and adjust settings as needed without being tied to a specific location.
  • Image/Text Watermark – Protect and brand your images with customizable watermarks. Watermarking helps safeguard your content from unauthorized use and adds a professional touch by incorporating your brand’s logo or other identifying marks directly onto your images.

No need for extra plugins for image compression, CDN, or watermarking. Everything you need is built-in, simplifying your workflow and enhancing your site’s speed and performance. Our comprehensive solution ensures that all your image optimization needs are met in one place, making it easier to maintain a fast, visually appealing, and professionally branded website.

For more details, visit PixJet Official Website.
sections.installation:
Follow these steps to get started with PixJet:
1. Install the Plugin:
– Download PixJet from PixJet’s Website or search for “PixJet” in your WordPress Admin Dashboard under Plugins > Add New.
– Upload the plugin ZIP file or install it directly from the Dashboard.

  1. Activate the Plugin:
    After installation, activate PixJet from your WordPress Plugins page.

  2. Connect with PixJet Server:
    Navigate to the PixJet Dashboard located in the WordPress admin menu. Follow the prompts to connect your WordPress site with the PixJet server.

  3. Configure the Plugin:
    Customize optimization, watermark settings, and CDN preferences in the plugin dashboard.

  4. Ready to Use:
    Once configured, PixJet will automatically optimize and protect any newly uploaded images.
sections.faq:
What happens when I activate PixJet?

PixJet will automatically optimize and watermark all newly uploaded images. Existing images will remain unchanged unless you explicitly optimize them through the plugin. If watermarking is enabled, it will be applied during the upload process.

Can PixJet be used with other image optimization, CDN, or watermarking plugins?

No, it’s recommended to avoid conflicts by deactivating similar plugins before using PixJet.

How does PixJet’s Premium CDN work?

PixJet’s CDN boosts the global delivery of your media files by caching content closer to your users, ensuring faster load times. This feature is available for select paid users and is activated only if you choose to enable it after connecting to the PixJet server.

Will the watermark feature overwrite my original images?

No, PixJet applies watermarks only to dynamically served images, leaving your originals untouched.

How do I get support?

You can find support and documentation at the official PixJet Support Center.
